mapper.select: select s.schedule_id, s.vaccine_code, s.vaccine_name, s.dose_no, s.total_doses, s.due_age_days, s.remind_before, s.remark, r.record_id, coalesce(r.inoculated, '0') as inoculated, r.inoculate_date, r.operator_name, (b.birth_date + (s.due_age_days || ' day')::interval)::date as due_date from nc_vaccine_schedule s inner join nc_baby b on b.baby_id = #{babyId} and b.del_flag = '0' left join nc_vaccine_record r on r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id and r.baby_id = b.baby_id order by s.sort_num, s.schedule_id
select schedule_id, vaccine_code, vaccine_name, dose_no, total_doses, due_age_days, remind_before, remark from nc_vaccine_schedule where schedule_id = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: insert into nc_vaccine_schedule (vaccine_code, vaccine_name, dose_no, total_doses, due_age_days, remind_before, sort_num, remark) values (#{vaccineCode}, #{vaccineName}, #{doseNo}, #{totalDoses}, #{dueAgeDays}, #{remindBefore}, #{sortNum}, #{remark})

insert into nc_vaccine_record (baby_id, schedule_id, inoculated, inoculate_date, operator_id, operator_name, create_time, update_time) values (#{babyId}, #{scheduleId}, #{inoculated}, #{inoculateDate}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName}, current_timestamp, current_timestamp) on conflict (baby_id, schedule_id) do update set inoculated = excluded.inoculated, inoculate_date = excluded.inoculate_date, operator_id = excluded.operator_id, operator_name = excluded.operator_name, update_time = current_timestamp
